title: Why the Aventador Was the Last of Its Kind
description:
On the twenty-sixth of September twenty twenty-two, Lamborghini announced that the last Aventador had been built, a light-blue Ultimae Roadster for a Swiss buyer. It closed eleven years of production and, in the company's words, the last pure naturally aspirated V12 built at Sant'Agata Bolognese. This is why the Aventador was the last of its kind, and where our sources disagree about how many were built. Our sources are Lamborghini's own press release, Motor Authority from September twenty twenty-two, Motor1 from July twenty twenty-one, Wikipedia's pages on the Aventador, Murciélago, Huracán and Revuelto, IEEE Spectrum and TechCrunch. They disagree on production totals, end dates and the last car. We show each version. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
